7591.title: Service environment omits the installer home
7591.rootCauseOneLine: The Linux installer recovers HOME only in its own process and omits it from the generated systemd service environment.

prReviews.topFinding: Installer HOME persistence and a daemon fallback target the mechanism, but linked code was not executed; six files and two subsystems exceed the simple-fix gate.

7591.proposedFix: Persist an escaped HOME in the machine service; separately review a startup fallback for existing units.
7591.caveats: Actual systemd enrollment was not run because PID 1 is dumb-init. Reproduced generation and isolated Git behavior in two clean trusted checkouts. No fix PR: installer packaging changes are excluded. Reproduction code is inline under report-repository policy.
